content: The public LangExtract README presents lx.extract results, source grounding via char_interval (None when the extraction is not in the source), JSONL save, and interactive HTML visualization. It does not document internal stages (prompt text, chunks, raw model output, parse versus align). The local examples/ollama/demo_ollama.py runs several examples, writes JSONL and HTML, and defaults to gemma2:2b. Source: https://github.com/google/langextract/blob/main/README.md and the repo demo.
